title: International Register of Open Abdomen
brief_summary: To evaluate the different indications to Open Abdomen, the different techniques used to perform it, it's management, it's definitive closure and mortality rates linked to the different variables. Moreover to evaluate the 1 month and 1 year follow up in patients underwent to Open Abdomen.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* No age limit
* Indication to Open Abdomen
* Informed consent

Exclusion Criteria:

* Informed consent refusal
* No indication to Open Abdomen
study_population: All patients who may require to be undergone to open abdomen procedure
